notes.title: September 24 Update Notes
notes.content:
September 24 Update Notes:
[olist]
[*] Removed the restriction where levels completed after viewing hints do not count toward achievements. Note: Levels completed with hints still will not be counted on the leaderboards.
[*] (If you have existing save data, you can replay any level to refresh your achievements.)
[*] We have optimized the achievement icons in the STEAM backend.
[*] The default language setting on the main menu has been changed to English.
[/olist]

notes.title: "Puyo! Push Brain" is scheduled for release on January 8th at 17:00 (UTC+8)!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is Liquid Meow Games.

"Puyo! Push Brain" is a creative puzzle game jointly developed by SkyStudio and Liquid Meow Games.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336590/_/

This game features over 100 levels for you to challenge, including puzzle box pushing, various mechanical transformations, block elimination, and special mechanisms for controlling multiple characters simultaneously.

Players will join the Puyo family and their friends to complete these levels and ultimately reach every finish point.

The game is scheduled for release on January 8th at 17:00 (UTC+8)!
-------------------------------------------------
[h1][Diverse levels, fun experiences]
[/h1]The Puyo family invites you to exercise your brain together. Conquer over 100 meticulously designed levels and showcase your exceptional mental prowess! Demonstrate your vigor and vitality!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308178/8323c914f1e588b6ec517e1f12bbfc899a668390.jpg[/img]
Push boxes to clear a path, use blocks to fill in dark spaces, manipulate various mechanisms, and control multiple characters to work together towards the finish block.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308178/00231050ede70135eada95d532d9b0da61792956.jpg[/img]


[h1][Diverse Themes, Unique Adventures]
[/h1]Clearing specific levels unlocks skins and themes, with a total of 5 types available.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308178/2fc5f37aaf3f0e12b829cfe9f340df49c3d3eb12.gif[/img]

[h1][An Adventure of Brainpower, Let's Climb to the Top]
[/h1]Players with the most levels cleared can make it to the leaderboard. Completing all levels and finishing the mental workout will earn you the recognition of the Puyo family. (Of course, as long as you have the courage to try, the Puyo family will also appreciate you!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308178/e1a8a018418b37bb4ee8576e199a704df4470cad.gif[/img]

[h1]Game Features
[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Unique gameplay that combines the novel puzzle-solving experience of box-pushing.
[*] Over 100 game levels, providing you with hours of fun.
[*] 5 different game skins.
[*] Leave your name on the leaderboard.
[*] Retro pixel art style.
[/olist]
